info.name: Adobe Lightroom Lightroom Albums Album Assets Renditions API
Adobe Lightroom Get an Asset Rendition

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset (UUID format)

params.name: rendition_type
params.description: Rendition size type. thumbnail2x is a small thumbnail, numeric values indicate the longest edge in pixels, and fullsize is the maximum resolution available.

items.docs: Retrieves a server-generated rendition of the asset at the specified size. Renditions are JPEG preview images generated from the master file with current develop settings applied.
